subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk be enabled by implicit OpenAI realtime credential availability, or only by explicit realtime readiness/preflight before microphone and WebRTC startup?
rationale: Current code and docs support realtime provider/auth resolution, while this report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either direction changes setup semantics and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Gate on Gateway readiness preflight
options.body: Use `talk.catalog.realtime.ready` or an equivalent Gateway-owned preflight to disable or block Talk before microphone startup while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep implicit credential activation
options.body: Accept that configured OpenAI realtime credentials enable browser Talk and limit the remaining fix to clearer provider/API errors when the media leg fails.

options.title: Require explicit realtime config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when `talk.realtime` is explicitly configured, with migration or docs for users relying on implicit credentials.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway readiness preflight
recommendation.body: Use `talk.catalog.realtime.ready` or an equivalent Gateway-owned preflight to disable or block Talk before microphone startup while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged OpenAI realtime auth and docs work makes this the closest current owner trail for the enablement-policy choice.
